subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close once a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require broader switch feedback, live-target tuple proof, and optional identity/switcher/prefix UX?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested workspace context, one open PR implements a focused breadcrumb, another open PR removes the breadcrumb surface, and the issue includes optional UX beyond the focused implementation.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher, prefix, color, and live-target proof ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require the implementation to cover switch feedback and stronger live-target tuple proof before this issue can close.

options.title: Replace Header Surface
options.body: Choose the no-breadcrumb/topbar direction and redesign multi-agent/workspace certainty in another persistent UI surface before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a rebased focused breadcrumb lands, then close it while tracking optional switcher, prefix, color, and live-target proof ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is the strongest feature-history match for the active-agent Dashboard header breadcrumb surface.
